in_sanskrit.name: Pupu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Petal of a flower
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pupu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Pupu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘pūpa’ which means a flower or a bud. It is a unisex name that signifies new beginnings, fertility, and love. In Hindu culture, flowers are considered sacred and are often used in rituals and pujas.
